key_insight: MedRealMM is a real-world multimodal benchmark that tests medical LLMs on authentic Chinese online consultation cases with both text and patient-uploaded images.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark better reflects clinical practice and safety needs than synthetic or multiple-choice tests, helping identify whether models can support online physician-style responses.
method: Built from de-identified patient-doctor interactions from a nationwide Chinese internet hospital
Used a Multimodal Clinical Challenge Point framework to extract clinically demanding moments and turn them into next-response tasks
Added physician-refined rubrics to score desirable, unsafe, unsupported, and contradictory responses
evidence_signal: The release includes 5,620 real-world multimodal cases across 64 departments and evaluates 19 general-purpose and medical-specialized LLMs.
watch_item: Because it is an offline benchmark from one online-hospital source, performance may not fully generalize to other languages, settings, or real-time clinical workflows.
paper_title: MedRealMM: A Real-World Multimodal Benchmark for Chinese Online Medical Consultation
